title: Elite: Bridge-Rib Breach
description: Oath Under Thunder: Bridge-Rib Breach unfolds across storm-slick rune-iron bridge with oath-stones, broken railings, and thunder channels built into the span, pushing the one active Asgardian Titan to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: Bridge-Rib Breach advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: storm-slick rune-iron bridge with oath-stones, broken railings, and thunder channels built into the span

objectives.primary: Claim two oath-stones before the storm breaks battle line. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.
optional: Trigger at least three Oathbound counterattacks
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn

specialRules: Oathbound Guard: Titans that survive damage near oath-stones empower their next committed strike.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Elite Storm: lightning collapse advances one turn earlier.
Elite Banner Law: enemy buffs persist until objective action breaks the source.
victoryConditions: Claim two oath-stones before the storm breaks battle line. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe integrity or turn pressure

activeTitanDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard one active Titan; nonstandard modes require explicit Creator approval.
meaningfulDifferences: Boss or elite wave uses altered entry timing
